## Validation

- [ ] Backend tests pass (`make backend-test`)
- [ ] Frontend unit tests pass (`make frontend-test`)
- [ ] Frontend typecheck passes (`make lint`)
- [ ] Frontend build passes (`make build`)
- [ ] Playwright E2E tests pass (`make frontend-e2e`)
- [ ] Screenshots/demo media updated when UI changes

## Data Quality

- [ ] New metrics identify whether values are official, estimated, or demo-only
- [ ] Documentation explains any public-data limitations
- [ ] No fabricated data — null/missing is preferred over invented values
